title: Kissed Charred Greek Chicken with Avgolemono Sauce
description: A flavorful and refreshing Greek-inspired dish featuring kissed charred chicken, served with a tangy avgolemono sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together 1 cup Greek yogurt, 2 tbsp olive oil, and 1 tsp kissed herbs (if using).
Add the chicken breasts to the marinade and mix to coat. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the avgolemono sauce.
In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp olive oil, and 1 egg.
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the sliced chicken with avgolemono sauce and garnish with tomato slices.
